# About CenterPoint.
An independent Chicago company focused entirely on community association management.

## Association management, and nothing else.

CenterPoint Association Management manages condominium, homeowners, and townhome associations in Chicago and the surrounding suburbs. We do not manage rental apartments, individual rental properties, or tenant leasing. Every hour goes to the boards and owners of the communities we serve.

CenterPoint is a newly established, independent corporation with its own contracts, accounts, and brand. Our leadership has managed Chicago condominium and homeowners associations for many years, and that experience shapes how we work: clear financials, documented decisions, and steady communication.

## How we work with boards.

### Financial transparency
Association funds held in the association's name, monthly statements reconciled to the bank, and reserve figures that match the balance sheet.

### Reliable communication
Board questions answered promptly, owners informed before work begins, and a written record of what was decided and why.

### Proactive maintenance
Preventive maintenance calendars, competitive bids, insured contractors, and capital plans that look past this fiscal year.

### Guidance for volunteer boards
Practical direction on Illinois association law, budgets, and procedure, with association counsel involved when a question needs it.

## Where we work.

We serve associations across [Chicago](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/property-management-chicago) and the [North Shore and nearby suburbs](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/property-management-north-shore). See every [service area](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/service-areas).
